Steven Young

Green candidate for Governor & Lieutenant Governor, Minnesota · Open seat

Light rail conductor; former corporate attorney

Steven (Steve) Young is a Minneapolis resident, a former corporate attorney and a U.S. Marine Corps veteran. The Green Party of Minnesota endorsed him for governor, with Jane Kirby for lieutenant governor, at its state convention on April 18, 2026. Because the Green Party does not have major-party status in Minnesota, the Young/Kirby ticket got on the ballot by nominating petition and filed on June 2, 2026.

Where Young stands

Taxes and affordability
His party's candidate page says the Young/Kirby ticket supports taxing the rich and corporations fairly and a universal basic income.
Taxes and affordability
Has said Minnesotans should stop paying federal taxes so the money does not fund Israel or the military. He told Alpha News, "under me, we'll all stop paying federal taxes."
Health care
Supports universal, single-payer health care.
Immigration enforcement
Supports abolishing ICE and making Minnesota a sanctuary state. His campaign motto is "Pro-Water, Anti-ICE."
Data centers and environment
Proposes banning hyperscale data centers in Minnesota and supports protecting water and habitat.
Child care
Supports universal child care.
Israel/Gaza
Supports divesting from Israel and the boycott, divestment and sanctions (BDS) movement. He has criticized Amy Klobuchar over U.S. funding for the war in Gaza.
Elections and campaign finance
His party's candidate page says the ticket supports proportional representation, ranked choice voting for statewide races, full public campaign financing, and ending corporate personhood and the idea that money counts as speech.

Background

  • Green Party of Minnesota endorsed candidate for governor, 2026 (running mate: Jane Kirby)
  • Light rail conductor (per Alpha News, Sept. 2026)
  • Corporate attorney, about 9 years; says he resigned in December 2025 when Operation Metro Surge began
  • U.S. Marine Corps, 12 years, infantry unit leader
  • Volunteer on the Minneapolis Food Council; high school lacrosse coach for 7 years; volunteer with Veterans For Peace
  • No prior elected office found
  • Lives in the Bryn Mawr neighborhood of Minneapolis; age 42 on Election Day

In the news

  • Green Party governor candidate wants to abolish ICE, slams Klobuchar over Gaza Alpha News, September 24, 2026
